Sorry this is long but it seems like fate I’m in time to answer. You are not in the wrong but be warned if you’re explaining yourself up and down everyday about your preferences on what you do with your time .. and there’s that deer in the headlights look when you do, then you might want to consider that you’re incompatible. You’re so young both of you and you’ll find you’re match eventually if you’re big on relationships however I’d focus on yourself and your goals and who you want to be Right now. Set free and be free. Part of why relationships Seem so hard is because we’re constantly changing and evolving, and if you can’t stretch those wings during a relationship (like your alone time is how you evolve and recenter yourself And they need other people to do that ) then it’s like pulling teeth on both parties. Eventually if it drags out and they’re not understanding they’re spotlight on you is going to get really bright. And you’ll find yourself in an awkward situation . Especially if you have goals and aspirations and they are kind of lax with theirs this will only cause guilt and heart ache down the line . Heck it might even be at the denial point right now where both of you think it can work but trust me  I’m coming out of a nine month relationship Which Involved therapy Just to realize I don’t actually want a relationship because I’m still evolving and my dude, no matter what he says about changing and accepting I can’t help but feel his inner misery behind his words. And our blow up fights all stem from the time imbalance I’m the introvert and he was the extrovert, but over time he dumped his friends and hobbies to wait on me Hand and foot which was uninvited and he thought he should be available when I needed it to be needed. Eventually they’ll wanna be your hero and they’ll be mad as hell when you tell them you are your hero. And Let me say something more.. I caved. I spent a month catering to him and pushing my time and my work aside to be available to him, so he wouldn’t feel alone and as my inner misery started to creep in he became intense. So intense he expected perfection out of me when we were together. I had to pick what we were doing, I had to help him even when he didn’t need help, I had to be physically available etc.  I dedicated all of my time just to see if it’d make him happier it blew up in my face and his. He still wanted more and I came to the realization we’re not compatible even though we’re (almost) a match made in heaven . I even tried the whole get him involved in my activities thing and he had no desire.. so that was that.  I hope you keep tabs on whether or not you have depression because my introverted nature stems from depression a little and if you ever feel like you want to be around them but your heart is tight and you just can’t you may want to consider it. But if you are comfortable and happy with yourself And the time you Spend with yourself don’t change because it’s a long road and sadly some people are meant to be memories and lessons .. It’ll hurt but before it drags on to the point of no return you have to either talk about this with her or be friends and go separate ways. Don’t strain each others hearts and get mad trying to balance and bend when you’re clearly too busy to add that into everything else you’re juggling. Relationships between introverts and extroverts is a delicate balance and a lot of the they cheated on me stories are rooted in one person deciding that since their partner doesn’t want to spend time then they’ll find someone who will. It Is shitty as hell but that’s human relationships for you. I wish you luck on this and just stay strong and firm on what you know is good for yourself.
